hypothesis: FCLR-H008: funding-conditioned price features improve out-of-sample forecasts of modeled hypothetical long/short liquidation-boundary breaches within a fixed horizon beyond a mark-price-only baseline on the disjoint 2024-04..2026-10 cohort, judged on out-of-sample AUC/log-loss/Brier.
target: whether future mark-price path breaches pre-registered hypothetical long/short liquidation boundary within fixed horizon (Track-B modeled boundary-breach proxy, never observed liquidation)
boundaries: derived from disclosed constant margin/leverage scenarios (not data-driven)
labels: separate long/short breach labels per horizon; modeled proxy only
splits: 60/20/20 by unique UTC timestamp on S; 168h purge/embargo; test -> 3 chronological blocks

models.B1: mark-price-only baseline (RV1h, RV24h, RV168h features), train-only scaling
models.C2: funding-conditioned (signed funding(24h), trailing 90d |funding| pct, mark/index premium, mark/EMA24 distance + mark price), train-only scaling

primary_contrast: C2 vs B1 on paired test-set out-of-sample AUC / log-loss / Brier
inference: >=2000 deterministic block-bootstrap replicates (block=24 rows, seed=20261126); leave-one-symbol-out (5 symbols)
decision_rule: FORECAST_GATE_PASSED iff C2 vs B1 improves on primary target AND materiality floor met AND CI supports improvement; else NOT_SUPPORTED / INCONCLUSIVE; symmetric verdict only
leakage_controls: no outcome inspection before design freeze
read-only cache reuse; no re-download; stdlib only; no network
note: Outcome-blind prereg frozen before any outcome computation. Track-B modeled boundary-breach forecast (NOT a risk overlay; campaign-07 forecast gate did NOT pass, so per RESEARCH_PROMPT section 9 no risk overlay is authorized).
